name: Enfeeblement
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Choose a creature within medium range and roll Spirit vs. Spirit. On a win, the creature deals half damage with Strength-based attacks. On a loss, roll 1d4. The result is subtracted from the damage the creature deals with Strength-based attacks.

Describe the effects of the curse.
successes:
✨: You may sustain the spell for up to 1 minute.

🌞: On a win, the creature instead deals 1/4 damage with Strength-based attacks.
